contract: delta_as_reported is the acceptance guard's own number: mean nearest-neighbour distance of the positive arm minus the paired control, over settled x_plus in WORLD coordinates. delta_single_frame is the same quantity with settled positions shifted back into their own container's frame, so container membership is carried once, by container_index, instead of also by a 2.5 m offset in the position term. Single-container boards are unaffected by construction and are reported separately as the control on this control.
